title: Record one signed six-entry n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/8, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, -1/16, 0)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest is `3/2`. The right shear alone is `625/512`, the next four proper prefixes are `21/16`, and the next five are `11/8`. This is the signed six-entry step left open by #4800. The branch is from fetched main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` and does not replay that open package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(1/8, 3/64, 25/512, -5/4096)`. The right shear drops the last quotient entry, so its bottom row is `1 + 1/8 + 3/64 + 25/512 = 625/512`, the same opening value as the positive six-entry symbol. The even child's right shear lifts the next four proper prefixes to `21/16`. The even grandchild's left shear, with entry `1/16`, lifts the next five to `11/8`. The even child's left shear carries the flipped coefficient as `-9/128` and lifts the running product to `3/2`, and the remaining 10 proper prefixes stay there. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

`625/512 < 21/16 < 11/8 < 3/2 < 9/4`. The sign changes the even child from `(1, 1/8, 1/16, 1/16)` to `(1, 1/8, 1/16, -1/16)`. Every proper-prefix infinity norm matches the positive six-entry path. The Schur child is `(1, 7/64, 25/512, -325/4096)`. Nine nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-signed-six-entry`
- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_SIGNED_SIX_ENTRY` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T20:18:04Z and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T20:20:29Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.

Prepared by James Reed with substantial Cursor Grok 4.7 assistance.
